bio: There are myriad reasons why we all eat out – to meet up with friends, to be seen, to celebrate special events – but at the most basic level it’s about getting fed, and no one feeds you quite like Ask for Luigi. Pasta is the order of the day, whether that’s pappardelle with rich duck ragu or bigoli with an abundance of shellfish; dishes that are as generous in size as they are in flavor—many plates are large enough for two. If you can take on Luigi’s meatballs and still finish your pasta dish, then take a bow.It’s a cute little corner spot, more cabin than restaurant, with just 32 seats, and everything has been cleverly thought through. So, start with an aperitivo, be prepared to share and do explore the exclusively Italian wine list....
